text: This thing moving on the screen resembles tumbleweed even though it is probably something else -- specially due to its darker color (or maybe just because this is a night storm scene). I believe that it is shown here in order to convey the idea of strong wind blowing stuff such as dust or even lager particles. The frames of the animation also seem to depict it rotating and kicking in the floor, but it seems to have pretty light weight in order to float like that.
